title: fix: accept PDF document blocks on /v1/messages
author: voodoohop

gist.summary: Fixed /v1/messages rejecting Anthropic document blocks, including PDFs placed in tool_result by Claude Code’s Read tool. Base64 PDF documents are translated to Chat file parts, plain-text documents to text parts, and cache_control is preserved; PDFs inside tool_result open a user message as tool-result images do. Unsupported url, content, and file document sources return a 400 that names the source. PDF handling still follows the underlying Chat provider’s support: Claude on Bedrock and Azure GPT return 400 for PDFs, while Gemini 3 Flash ignores them.
